battleTraits.name: Rune of Fiery Determination
battleTraits.effect:
Rune of Fiery Determination (Once Per Battle (Army), Any Hero Phase): You can only use this ability if you have not used any Ur-gold Rune abilities this battle round.
Friendly Fyreslayers units have Ward (5+) for the rest of the battle round.

battleTraits.name: Rune of Farsight
battleTraits.effect:
Rune of Farsight (Once Per Battle (Army), Your Shooting Phase): Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. In addition,
for the rest of the battle round, ranged weapons, including Companion weapons, used by friendly Fyreslayers units have Crit (2 Hits).

battleTraits.name: Rune of Relentless Zeal
battleTraits.effect:
Rune of Relentless Zeal (Once Per Battle (Army), Your Movement Phase): You can only use this ability if you have not used any Ur-gold Rune abilities this battle round.
For the rest of the battle round, friendly Fyreslayers units can use Charge abilities even if they used a Run ability in the same turn.

battleTraits.name: Rune of Searing Heat
battleTraits.effect:
Rune of Searing Heat (Once Per Battle (Army), Any Combat Phase): You can only use this ability if you have not used any Ur-gold Rune abilities this battle round.
Melee weapons used by friendly Fyreslayers units have Crit (Mortal) for the rest of the battle round.

battleTraits.name: Rune of Fury
battleTraits.effect:
Rune of Fury (Once Per Battle (Army), Start of Any Turn): You can only use this ability if you have not used any Ur-gold Rune abilities this battle round.
For the rest of the battle round, friendly Fyreslayers units have Strike-first while they are in combat with an enemy unit that charged in the same turn.

artefacts.name: Droth-helm
artefacts.effect: Droth-helm: Add 1 to hit rolls for Companion weapons used by friendly Fyreslayers units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

artefacts.name: Draught of the Finest Magmalt
artefacts.effect: Draught of the Finest Magmalt: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase Add 3 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

artefacts.name: Ash-cloud Rune
artefacts.effect: Ash-cloud Rune: Once Per Battle, Enemy Hero Phase Until the start of your next turn, friendly Infantry units cannot be targeted by shooting attacks while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

heroicTraits.name: Ash-beard
heroicTraits.effect: Ash-beard: If this unit is not a Priest, they have Priest (1). If this unit was already a Priest, add 1 to this unit's chanting rolls.

heroicTraits.name: Blood of the Berzerker
heroicTraits.effect: Blood of the Berzerker: Add 1 to charge rolls for friendly Fyreslayers units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

heroicTraits.name: Fiercely Competitive
heroicTraits.effect: Fiercely Competitive: If this unit is in combat with an enemy unit that has Strike-first, this unit has Strike-first. If this unit is in combat with an enemy unit that uses the 'All-out Attack' command, add 1 to hit rolls for this unit's attacks for the rest of the turn

battleFormations.name: Forge Brethren
battleFormations.effect: Bulwark of Molten Stone: Add 1 to save rolls for friendly Fyreslayers Infantry units while they are wholly within friendly territory.

battleFormations.name: Scales of Vulcatrix
battleFormations.effect: Ancient Bloodlines: Add 2 to the Health characteristic of friendly Magmadroth units.

battleFormations.name: Warrior Kinband
battleFormations.effect: Berserk Kindred: Add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly Fyreslayers Infantry units that charged in the same turn.

battleFormations.name: Lords of the Lodge
battleFormations.effect: Martial Pride and Stubborn Will: Add 3 to the control scores of friendly Fyreslayers Heroes. In addition, the control scores of Fyreslayers Heroes cannot be modified by enemy abilities.
